title: U.S. payrolls rose 162,000 in August, much more than expected; unemployment rate at 4.1%
summary: August nonfarm payrolls crushed forecasts by 3x (162K vs 53K expected), the strongest monthly gain since March. Fed September 16 rate hike odds surged to ~60%. Dow fell 271.86 pts (-0.51%), S&P 500 -0.38%, Nasdaq -0.29% on Friday Sep 4.
why: 就业数据大幅超预期，美联储9月16日加息概率从约50%跳升至~60%，2年期国债收益率触2025年1月以来新高；9月加息预期升温将压制风险资产，港股/美股Sell Put策略面临更高波动风险，需关注行权价与市场波动率变化。

title: China's Moonshot Said to Seek Up to $5 Billion in Hong Kong IPO This Year
summary: Moonshot AI (maker of Kimi K3) confidentially filed for HK IPO targeting $3–5B. Company valued at ~$50B; Kimi K3 has 2.8T parameters and generates ~$300M annualized revenue. Microsoft, Amazon, Google in cloud distribution talks.
why: Kimi K3是中国最大开权重大模型，$500亿估值港股IPO将成今年港股科技板块最重要催化之一；消息已在9月4日推升恒生指数科技板块，港股AI/互联网持仓情绪进一步改善；后续上市条款细节将是重要催化剂。

title: Tesla's stock drops as Cybercab update 'underwhelms,' NHTSA probe
summary: NHTSA opened investigation into ~1,000 Tesla Cybercabs over FMVSS safety certification. The vehicle lacks steering wheel/pedals; Zoox faced same audit in 2022 and spent 4 years in regulatory limbo. TSLA fell ~5.92% on Sep 4 to ~$374.64.
why: 特斯拉Cybercab商业化刚起步即遭NHTSA审查，参照Zoox案例有4年拖延风险；Robotaxi叙事短期明显受挫，TSLA股价承压；对持有TSLA Sell Put的投资者需关注行权价支撑位，隐含波动率可能上升。

title: Hong Kong stocks rebound from choppy trading triggered by overnight turmoil in US
summary: Hang Seng Index rebounded Sep 4, breaking a multi-session losing streak. Tech led gains: Tencent +2.1%, Alibaba +1.8%, Meituan +1.3%, Xiaomi +0.8%, JD.com +2.5%. Moonshot AI IPO filing and Fed Waller's less-restrictive signal boosted sentiment.
why: 港股技术性企稳，科技互联网板块集体走强；Moonshot AI港股IPO消息成为重要催化；Fed Waller偏鸽信号暂时对冲了就业数据加息预期；恒指关键支撑区域需持续跟踪，对港股Sell Put策略有直接影响。

title: Tencent bought back 229,000 shares for HK$100.2 million on Sept 2, HKEX filing shows
summary: Tencent (00700.HK) repurchased 229,000 shares for HK$100.2M on Sep 2 per HKEX filing. Company has been buying back shares nearly every trading day since mid-May 2026, defending stock around HK$445.
why: 延续报道：腾讯持续每日回购，单日金额已从高峰期约5亿港元降至约1亿港元，规模有所收窄；回购仍是股价在低位的重要托底信号；对持有0700.HK Sell Put的投资者，回购力度变化是判断股价底部支撑的关键参考。

title: Circle Announces Founding Validator Cohort & Arc Integrations Ahead of September 16 Mainnet Launch
summary: Circle's Arc blockchain launches Sep 16 with 11 institutional founding validators including BlackRock, Visa, Mastercard, and DTCC. BlackRock's BUIDL tokenized money market fund will deploy on Arc. ARC token presale raised $222M at $3B FDV.
why: Arc上线使USDC成为机构级区块链的原生gas资产，BlackRock+Visa+Mastercard+DTCC的验证节点阵容意味着Circle从稳定币发行商升级为金融基础设施运营商；9月3日CRCL已涨16.46%至$103，9月16日Arc主网上线是下一个期权波动率事件。

title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Reports August 2026 Sales Results
summary: Costco net sales $23.70B in August (+9.9% YoY). FY2026 full-year net sales $297.3B (+10.2% YoY). Comparable sales +8.4%; digital comps +17.9%. Q4 & full-year earnings to be announced September 24.
why: 延续报道：Costco FY2026全年销售额$2,973亿（+10.2%）展现美国消费者强劲韧性，数字化销售持续高增；9月24日完整财报将是COST持仓的重要业绩事件，届时隐含波动率预计抬升，Sell Put策略需注意。
